observations.description: Full chapter and quay voice script is present
Imported audio loads: Mara / The tower's gone dark. I heard glass breaking in the clerk's office just now. Would you check on her? The door is beside the tower.
Imported audio loads: Mara / We've been paid, and the tower's burning again. I can see right across the quay from here.
Imported audio loads: Mara / The clerk needs that pouch back. Come on, I'll go to the office with you.
Imported audio loads: Mara / I'll meet you at the garden gate. Ivo will know where the thief went.
Imported audio loads: Mara / The payroll? That's our whole week's wages. Is the clerk hurt?
Imported audio loads: Mara / The tower's burning again. Would you check on the clerk? I heard glass breaking in her office. The door is beside the tower.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / I'll check on the clerk.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / She's safe. He stole the payroll. Will you come with me?
Imported audio loads: Corsair / What happened?
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Do you work here?
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Where is Ivo?
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Why is the tower dark?
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Share a flask of lantern oil.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Keep the oil for the road.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Leave conversation.
Imported audio loads: Mara / I'm coming. I mend dockhands as often as cargo nets. Tell Ivo we'll help him, and keep those machines off me while I tend your wounds.
Imported audio loads: Mara / A crash from the office, then someone running across the court. I couldn't see who it was. Ivo went after them.
Imported audio loads: Mara / I unload the boats and tend the tower lamp at night. The clerk pays us on Fridays. I was waiting for my wages when I heard the crash.
Imported audio loads: Mara / That's enough to get the tower burning again. Give me a moment to fill the reservoir. We should be able to see anyone else crossing the quay.
Imported audio loads: Mara / All right. Watch your footing by the water. Those boards are hard to see without the tower.
Imported audio loads: Mara / The reservoir ran dry. I was going to buy oil with tonight's pay. I should've fetched it before sunset.
Imported audio loads: Mara / He ran east, towards the garden gate. It's the only way onto that terrace.
Imported audio loads: Ivo / The man in red ran from the office into the garden. I've shut the gate behind him. There's no other way out, but he's got two mechanical guards.
Imported audio loads: Ivo / The clerk has the payroll and the quay has its light back. I'll keep watch here.
Imported audio loads: Ivo / Take the money back to the clerk. I'll stay with the prisoner until the watch arrives.
Imported audio loads: Ivo / Mara stays behind us. Keep the guards busy while we close on the thief.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Mara's ready. Let's get the payroll back.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Why haven't you gone in?
Imported audio loads: Corsair / What are those machines?
Imported audio loads: Ivo / I'll lift the chain. Stay together. Those guards hit hard, and Mara needs room to work.

Imported audio loads: Ivo / One of his guards nearly took my head off. I shut the gate and held my ground. Get Mara.

We'll need someone who can tend a wound.
Imported audio loads: Ivo / They're the raider's guards. One nearly took my head off when I tried to stop him. Keep clear of their weapons.
Imported audio loads: Clerk / I'm all right. He shoved past me and smashed the lock off the payroll chest. I couldn't even see his face until he was through the door.
Imported audio loads: Clerk / I've counted it twice. Nobody will lose their wages. We'll have that lock replaced in the morning.
Imported audio loads: Clerk / That pouch has the quay stamp on it. You found him! Let me count the money.
Imported audio loads: Clerk / Mara was waiting for her pay outside. Tell her I'm safe. Ivo chased the thief east, towards the garden.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Who was he? What did he take?
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Return the stolen payroll.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Could I use the market side passage?
Imported audio loads: Corsair / May I look through the harbor archive?
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Do robberies happen often here?
Imported audio loads: Clerk / I'll leave the side door unlatched. It cuts from this court to the market.
Imported audio loads: Clerk / The cabinet over there holds the harbor history. You can take the visitor's copy. Thankfully the thief wasn't interested in books.
Imported audio loads: Clerk / Pickpockets, sometimes. Armed robbery in my office? Never. With the tower out he got across the court before I saw him coming.
Imported audio loads: Filing Cabinet / A visitor's copy of the harbor history lies in the bottom drawer.
Imported audio loads: Filing Cabinet / You already have the visitor's copy. The remaining volumes belong in the archive.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Take the harbor history.
Imported audio loads: Narrator / The booklet describes the building of Lantern Quay and the little garden planted above its eastern sea wall.
Imported audio loads: Narrator / You close the drawer.
Imported audio loads: Narrator / Silver coins and folded wage slips fill the pouch. The clerk can account for them.
Imported audio loads: Vendor / Fresh rope, dry matches, and a map that has never met the tide.
Imported audio loads: Vendor / Mara has her money back? Good. Tell her the matches are on me.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Ask for directions through town.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Ask about the lantern tower.
Imported audio loads: Vendor / The market is west, the clerk's office is by the northern tower, and the garden is east. Ivo is at its gate.
Imported audio loads: Vendor / Mara tends it after the last boat unloads. When it burns, you can see clear from my stall to the garden gate.
Imported audio loads: Mara / Thank you. I'll stay here in case someone else needs help. Call if she's hurt.

Imported audio loads: Clerk / A red coat, with two iron guards behind him. He emptied the chest into a pouch and ran east. That's the dockworkers' pay. Tell Mara what happened, then find Ivo. He went after the thief.
Imported audio loads: Clerk / The whole payroll. Thank you. Mara, here's your week's wages. Buy the tower oil before anything else; I don't want another night like this.
Imported audio loads: Narrator / The raider is down. A heavy pouch hangs from his belt, stamped with the quay's mark.
Imported audio loads: Narrator / The chest has been forced open. Its broken lock lies on the floor. Scraps of wage envelopes are all that's left inside.
Imported audio loads: Narrator / The recovered payroll is back in the chest. The broken lock still needs replacing.
Imported audio loads: Ivo / There he is. The payroll pouch is on his belt.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / Give us the money. You have nowhere to go.
Imported audio loads: Crimson Raider / Then you should have stayed outside. Guards!
Imported audio loads: Ivo / I'll hold him here. Take the payroll back to the clerk.
Imported audio loads: Mara / Let's get everyone paid.
Imported audio loads: Mara / The tower's gone out. I was waiting for my pay to buy more oil.
Imported audio loads: Mara / Did you hear that? Glass breaking, over at the clerk's office.
Imported audio loads: Corsair / I'll check on her. Stay here.
Imported audio loads: Mara / There's enough oil now to keep the tower burning till morning.
Imported audio loads: Mara / I can see every plank again. Thank you for coming back with me.
Imported audio loads: Mara / Your oil kept the tower burning while we were gone. I've bought enough for the rest of the night.
